subject: math.OC
name: Weierstrass existence theorem for optimization
statement: A lower semicontinuous function f:K → ℝ ∪ {+∞} on a nonempty compact set K attains its infimum. If f is finite at some point, that minimum is finite.

subject: math.OC
name: Fermat stationary-point theorem
statement: If a differentiable real-valued function on an open subset of ℝⁿ has a local minimum or maximum at x*, then ∇f(x*) = 0.

subject: math.OC
name: First-order characterization of convexity
statement: A differentiable function f on an open convex subset of ℝⁿ is convex if and only if f(y) ≥ f(x) + ∇f(x)·(y−x) for every x,y in its domain. Consequently, any point with zero gradient is a global minimizer.

subject: math.OC
name: Karush–Kuhn–Tucker theorem under Slater’s condition
statement: For minimizing differentiable convex f₀ subject to differentiable convex fᵢ ≤ 0 and Ax = b, assume some x satisfies all inequalities strictly and Ax = b. A feasible x* is optimal if and only if there are λᵢ ≥ 0 and ν with ∇f₀(x*) + Σᵢ λᵢ∇fᵢ(x*) + Aᵀν = 0 and λᵢfᵢ(x*) = 0 for every i.

subject: math.OC
name: Slater strong-duality theorem
statement: For a convex program with real-valued convex objective and inequality functions on ℝⁿ and affine equality constraints, assume a strictly feasible point exists. If the primal optimal value is finite, it equals the Lagrangian dual optimal value, and the dual optimum is attained.

subject: math.OC
name: Farkas' lemma
statement: For a real matrix A and vector b, exactly one of the following holds: Ax = b has a solution with x ≥ 0; or there is y with Aᵀy ≥ 0 and bᵀy < 0.

subject: math.OC
name: Separating hyperplane theorem
statement: Two disjoint nonempty convex subsets of ℝⁿ can be separated by a nonzero linear functional if one is open. More precisely, there are a ≠ 0 and α such that a·x ≤ α ≤ a·y for all x in one set and y in the other.

subject: math.OC
name: Fenchel–Moreau theorem
statement: A proper lower semicontinuous convex function f:ℝⁿ → ℝ ∪ {+∞} equals its biconjugate f**, where f*(y) = supₓ(y·x−f(x)).

subject: math.OC
name: Fenchel–Rockafellar duality theorem
statement: Let f and g be proper lower semicontinuous convex functions on ℝⁿ and ℝᵐ, and A a linear map. If some x has f(x) finite and g is finite and continuous at Ax, and infₓ[f(x)+g(Ax)] is finite, this infimum equals maxᵧ[−f*(−Aᵀy)−g*(y)].

subject: math.OC
name: Sion minimax theorem
statement: Let X be a compact convex set and Y a convex set in real locally convex topological vector spaces. If a real-valued function f on X × Y is continuous, convex in x, and concave in y, then minₓ supᵧ f(x,y) = supᵧ minₓ f(x,y).

subject: math.OC
name: Von Neumann minimax theorem
statement: For any finite real matrix A, min over probability vectors p of max over probability vectors q of pᵀAq equals max over q of min over p of pᵀAq. Thus every finite two-player zero-sum game has a value in mixed strategies.

subject: math.OC
name: Lagrange multiplier theorem
statement: Suppose f and g₁,…,gₘ are C¹ near a constrained local minimizer x* satisfying gᵢ(x*) = 0. If the gradients ∇gᵢ(x*) are linearly independent, then ∇f(x*) is a linear combination of them.

subject: math.OC
name: Pontryagin minimum principle
statement: Consider x′ = f(t,x,u), fixed initial state, free terminal state, compact control set, and cost ∫₀ᵀ L(t,x,u) dt + Φ(x(T)), with f,L continuous and C¹ in x and Φ C¹. An optimal state-control pair admits an absolutely continuous costate p satisfying p′ = −∂ₓH, p(T) = ∇Φ(x(T)), and u(t) minimizes H(t,x(t),p(t),u) almost everywhere, where H = L + p·f.

subject: math.OC
name: Bellman optimality principle
statement: For a finite-horizon Markov decision process with finite state and action sets and terminal cost g, define Vₜ(x) as the least expected remaining cost. Then Vᵀ = g and Vₜ(x) = minₐ[cₜ(x,a) + E(Vₜ₊₁(Xₜ₊₁) | Xₜ=x, Aₜ=a)]; choosing an action attaining each minimum gives an optimal policy.

subject: math.OC
name: Kalman controllability rank theorem
statement: For the continuous-time linear system x′ = Ax + Bu on ℝⁿ, every state can be driven to every other state in any fixed positive time if and only if [B AB ⋯ Aⁿ⁻¹B] has rank n.

subject: math.OC
name: Kalman observability rank theorem
statement: For x′ = Ax and y = Cx on ℝⁿ, the initial state is uniquely determined by the output on any positive time interval if and only if the matrix obtained by stacking C, CA,…,CAⁿ⁻¹ has rank n.

subject: math.OC
name: Lyapunov matrix theorem
statement: A real matrix A has all eigenvalues with strictly negative real part if and only if, for every symmetric positive-definite Q, the equation AᵀP + PA = −Q has a unique symmetric positive-definite solution P.

subject: math.OC
name: Infinite-horizon linear-quadratic regulator theorem
statement: For x′ = Ax + Bu and cost ∫₀∞(xᵀQx + uᵀRu) dt, assume Q ≥ 0, R > 0, (A,B) stabilizable, and (Q¹/²,A) detectable. There is a unique positive-semidefinite stabilizing solution P of AᵀP + PA − PBR⁻¹BᵀP + Q = 0; the feedback u = −R⁻¹BᵀPx is optimal and the value is x₀ᵀPx₀.

subject: math.OC
name: LaSalle invariance principle
statement: Let K be a compact positively invariant set for a C¹ autonomous ODE and V a C¹ function with derivative along the flow at most zero on K. Every trajectory starting in K approaches the largest invariant subset of {x in K : V̇(x) = 0}.

subject: math.OC
name: Gradient descent convergence theorem
statement: If f:ℝⁿ → ℝ is convex with L-Lipschitz gradient, L > 0, and has a minimizer x*, then xₖ₊₁ = xₖ−∇f(xₖ)/L satisfies f(xₖ)−f(x*) ≤ L‖x₀−x*‖²/(2k) for every k ≥ 1.
